findings.evidence: Bool descriptor shape is fixed to 8-byte payload and extent at lines 700-708, but the scalar scan branch only checks readability and returns sizes.
findings.recommendation: After al_owning_scan_readable_in_owner confirms all eight bytes are available, decode little-endian and accept exactly 0 or 1. Keep the check in the Bool leaf path so primitive, nominal, and nested active Bool values share it.

findings.evidence: Sum tags and active children are bounded before loads; record child ranges are computed and recursively scanned. Only the active sum payload is traversed.
findings.recommendation: Test malformed active Bool leaves under record, Option Some, Result Ok and Result Error. Include a one-byte-short owner extent and malformed bytes in inactive branches to confirm short reads reject and inactive values remain unexamined.

findings.evidence: Primitive Bool uses TypeId 2 and nominal types have separate ordered IDs, but nominal scalar typeKind and host measure/encode currently accept only Int and String.
findings.recommendation: Map nominal Bool to kind 2; preserve its existing distinct nominal TypeId and 8-byte sizes. Add exact-name BoolValue host handling and assert two wrappers differ from primitive Bool and each other. Do not expect raw payload bytes to encode nominal identity; scanner callers select a type index.

findings.evidence: Scanner result fields are assigned only after successful scans. Mailbox scans all external inputs before reserving/copying them; after preflight it intentionally invalidates output metadata and publishes valid metadata only after output validation.
findings.recommendation: On malformed raw Bool, assert scanner output canaries and stack state remain unchanged; for mailbox callbacks assert failure status, the established invalid output marker, no callback-body commit, and unchanged parked roots/pending state where applicable.

alreadyCovered.covers: Bool descriptor shape is declared and primitive true storage is exercised; no scanner call uses AL_TEST_LAYOUT_BOOL.
External malformed String sentinel behavior, nested active String scanning, Option/Result tag checks, and short extents.
Nested refined String failures preserve retained output; raw malformed String invalidates mailbox outputs; active/inactive Option/Result Int refinement behavior.
Canonical 0/1 validator-result check and host Bool decoder validation. Neither validates raw native scanner ingress.

gaps.covers: No primitive or nominal Bool scan vectors for noncanonical values, short ranges, nested active children, or unchanged output canaries.
Current Bool wrapper cases only assert that Bool remains unsupported; there is no positive nominal Bool/native identity matrix.
No raw mailbox noncanonical Bool input or retained-root Bool remeasurement test; host Bool encoding only produces 0/1.
